overview: EduMind AI is a premium educational workspace that turns your study material into an AI-powered classroom with notebooks, sources, chat, notes, flashcards and quizzes.
features: Create subject notebooks and organize study material by chapter
Add sources as files, website links, YouTube links or typed notes
Ask questions and get answers grounded in your own sources with citations
Generate summaries, detailed notes, flashcards and quizzes
Practice with interactive flashcards and scored quizzes with explanations
Search across notebooks, sources, notes, flashcards and conversations
Explore a ready-made Indian Economy demo notebook
Dark and light mode with a fully responsive layout
